title: Looking Ahead to the Sharjah International Publishers Conference
excerpt: Following Frankfurt, publishers and rights professionals gather in Sharjah on 1–3 November. We look back on our previous editions and wish all participants a productive conference.
image_alt: Epsilon Publishing Group's table 162 with its 2025 catalogues at the Publishers Conference in Sharjah
body:
Following Frankfurt, the international publishing community is preparing for another important meeting point: the Sharjah International Publishers Conference, taking place from 1–3 November 2026.

Bringing together publishers, literary agents and rights professionals from around the world, the conference begins with a day of roundtable discussions on the industry's evolving priorities, followed by two days dedicated to B2B meetings, rights negotiations and international collaboration.

Although we will not be attending this year, we are pleased to look back on our participation in the previous editions, where we held valuable meetings, strengthened professional relationships and explored new opportunities for our titles.

We wish all participants a productive conference and many promising conversations in Sharjah.
